title.narrative: Commonwealth Connectivity Agenda and Trade Ministers Meeting

description.narrative: The project will support the delivery of the Connectivity Action Plan by (1) convening the Trade Ministers Meeting, Senior Trade Officials, and technical cluster meetings as platforms for the exchange of knowledge and experiences (2) evidence for policymaking and (3) action to build capacities and reform the policy and regulatory environment. The project will continue the delivery of the Connectivity Action Plan (CAP).
